# Debrief: Argo CD, Prometheus

These clips offer an Argo CD team practical guidance on avoiding imperative anti-patterns, previewing pull request changes with a real Argo CD instance, and using Argo CD's API to troubleshoot, with only a passing mention of Prometheus. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 8:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=526s); [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 5:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=326s); [The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 15:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=924s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. Creating Argo CD applications through a custom CLI that generates manifests on the fly and applies them without storing anything in Git is an anti-pattern that undermines declarative GitOps. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 8:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=526s))
2. Rendering pull request previews with a real Argo CD instance matches production configuration one-to-one and runs in isolation; the main downside is speed, which the speakers worked to reduce. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 5:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=326s))
3. Argo CD's API can extract application logs, Kubernetes events, and live versus desired state, helping troubleshooting and reducing data silos across tools like Splunk, Wavefront for Prometheus metrics, and Grafana. ([The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 15:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=924s))

## Action items

- [ ] Audit how your Argo CD applications are created and check whether any internal tool or CLI applies manifests to Argo CD without committing them to Git. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 8:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=526s))
- [ ] Try previewing pull request changes by rendering manifests through a real Argo CD instance, and limit rendering to only the applications affected by a change to keep it fast. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 5:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=326s); [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 16:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=976s))
- [ ] Experiment with using the Argo CD API to pull logs, events, and live versus desired state into one place for troubleshooting alongside your existing Prometheus metrics. ([The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 15:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=924s))

## Watch together (8 min)

1. [Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 8:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=526s) (1:19), Regina Voloshin: Explains an imperative anti-pattern that breaks declarative Argo CD usage.
2. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 5:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=326s) (1:18), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Shows real Argo CD rendering for accurate pull request previews.
3. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 16:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=976s) (1:19), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Details scoping rendering to changed applications to cut preview time.
4. [The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 15:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=924s) (2:27), Alexander Matyushentsev, Leonardo Luz Almeida: Shows Argo CD API as a troubleshooting data source across silos.
5. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s) (1:19), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Covers a locked-down, namespace-scoped Argo CD with roughly 5-second previews.
